All the rewards are credited to a user's balance and can be withdrawn to a bank account or sent to other users. Users can present a barcode with their client ID at the checkout to redeem offers. The app also provides a list of partner stores.

title: Customer Service Automation with Dynamic Data Access
description:
Lasyaaitech's Customer Service Automation platform is built to enhance support efficiency by integrating dynamic data access into customer interaction workflows. Designed for fast-paced enterprise environments, the system enables support teams to instantly retrieve order history, status updates, and personalized insights without toggling between systems.

By leveraging AI-driven routing and pre-populated suggestions, the platform automates routine queries and escalates complex issues to the right agents with full context. With integrated CRM and API access to third-party systems, businesses can reduce resolution time, improve customer satisfaction, and maintain a consistent support experience across all channels.

Whether it's chat, email, or call-based service, this dynamic solution transforms fragmented support into a unified, intelligent process.

Built on AWS Lambda, S3, and Textract, it supports high-volume processing, seamless data extraction, and secure storage. The system enables role-based access control, audit trails, and customizable templates—ensuring compliance, speed, and accuracy at scale.

The platform has been successfully integrated into HR, legal, and financial departments, significantly reducing manual work and increasing turnaround time for document workflows.

title: Passenger Experience AI Assistance Bot
description:
The Passenger Experience AI Assistance Bot is an intelligent, real-time conversational assistant designed specifically for airport and airline passengers. It helps travelers with tasks like tracking luggage, receiving gate change alerts, accessing flight schedules, and managing travel documents—all via voice or chat interface.

The bot integrates seamlessly with airline databases and digital twin systems to provide proactive notifications, contextual support, and multilingual assistance. With AI-driven personalization, the system improves traveler satisfaction and operational efficiency across terminals, especially during delays or disruptions.

Passengers benefit from quicker resolutions, fewer manual inquiries, and a more informed travel experience—all delivered through mobile, kiosk, or web platforms.
